chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Sayf ibn Umeyra, from Abu al-Subbah, who said:

By Allah, Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him) said to me: 'Allah taught His Prophet the Revelation (al-Tanzil) and the Interpretation (al-Ta'wil). So the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) taught Ali (peace be upon him).' He said: 'And He taught us, by Allah.' Then he said: 'Whatever you do, or oaths you swear during dissimulation (taqiyyah), you are in a state of leeway (ease) from it.'

key_terms.التَّنْزِيل: Revelation (the literal text of the Quran)
key_terms.تَقِيَّة: Dissimulation (concealing one's faith in dangerous circumstances)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on oaths sworn during taqiyyah according to Ja'far al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi highlights the transmission of divine knowledge from the Prophet to Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS), emphasizing the dual nature of revelation as both literal (Tanzil) and interpretive (Ta'wil). It establishes a key juristic principle that oaths taken for the sake of taqiyyah (dissimulation) are not binding, granting believers leeway (sahh) from their expiation, a concept rooted in the flexibility of Shia fiqh regarding self-preservation.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Sayf Bin Umeyra, from Abu Al Sabbah who said,

‘By Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> Bin Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> had said to me: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Taught His<sup>azwj</sup> Prophet<sup>saww</sup> the Revelation and the interpretation. So Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> taught Ali<sup>asws</sup>. By Allah<sup>azwj</sup> he<sup>asws</sup> taught us<sup>asws</sup>’. Then he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘What you all do from something, or oaths are sworn against you during dissimulation, so you are in a leeway from it’.
en.sarwar: 15. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Sayf ibn Amirah am abu al-Sabbah who has narrated the following:

“By Allah, Ja‘far ibn Muhammad, ‘Alayhim al-Salam, said to me that Allah taught Tamil and Taw’il (what was revealed and what it meant) to the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, who taught it to Ali, ‘Alayhi al- Salam.’ He (the Imam) said, ‘He by Allah taught to us. Thus, if you do certain things or take an oath and swear because of taqiyah (fear), then you are not under constraint.’”
